analysis:
Integration of all 14 units. The visible PR is documentation (changelog.d/gptoss-bf16-activations.md; docs/architecture/hardware-support.md:113; docs/architecture/inference.md:1353; docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md:689; docs/reference/configuration.md:594), comment-only edits in EngineV2Bridge.swift (~132-136), EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (~201-204) and EngineV2KVSizing.swift (8-10), test fixture updates (SegmentedFleetGeometry.swift 45-48, SegmentedProductionGrantTests.swift 82-84, EngineV2PrefixCacheWiringTests comments), and a libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump 0351444e -> f2eb29b8.

No executable provider code in the supplied evidence changes crypto, attestation, authorization, wire protocol, cache scoping, TTL, HMAC lookup tags or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, so T-041 mitigations and TB-002/003/009/011 are unaffected. The doc claims (SSD checkpoints with float32 layer types use a different namespace and expire; sizes halve) are consistent with T-041: no new at-rest kind, and old files age out by TTL/LRU or KEK wipe.

Unverified contracts, which I record rather than report as findings: (1) The real behavior change is in the submodule (expert SwiGLU clamp dtype, GPTOSS+Experts.swift), which is not supplied. Its diff could also touch KV, prefix-cache or MTP code relevant to TB-007, T-028 and T-041. (2) The changelog says admission, paged storage and checkpoint identity already use observed native K/V types. EngineV2SlotFactory.slotKVBytesPerToken was not supplied. Checkpoint identity must include per-layer dtype so bf16 and float32 payloads can never be cross-restored (AAD/HMAC input). (3) The gpt-oss-20b 3.5 GiB activation floor was measured on the float32 path and has not been re-measured. Doubled token capacity per grant could create memory-pressure/availability risk (T-029 class) if the floor is wrong. This is disclosed in the docs and is not a demonstrated regression. The fallback nativeKVBytesPerToken over-reserves for bf16, which is fail-safe. (4) Test fixtures now assume 24x bf16; if the production SDK still produced fp32 rows, tests would mis-size admission.

No finding is supported. A reviewer of the submodule diff should confirm items 1-3 before concluding.
